def verifySigns (xs : List Int) : Option (List Bool) := xs.mapM exactSign

  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [verifySigns]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [verifySigns, exactSign, ih]
      by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> simp [hx]
